mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to historical averages compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 5-day SPX returns is negative (i.e., < 0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a contraction in both consumer and business sector activity, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline by > 0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-rate monetary regime (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%), the Federal Reserve's accommodative stance supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between PAYEMS and 20-day SPX returns is negative (i.e., < 0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand for housing, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced construction sector activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate monetary tightening combined with labor market weakness, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE increase by > 0.25 percentage points from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate output and profitability, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.
